given: R1 build: Bulk Pass deferred (SPEC 1.2.0, §7.6); item a has a reserved bulk_eligible flag set true
when: e1 attempts a bulk pass of items a and b
e1 records an individual check on a carrying a non-null bulk_group_id

notes: Deferred-feature contract for R1. The pre-1.2.0 Bulk Pass scenario (BLK-1–BLK-4: five separate attributed records, two rejections, concurrent exclusion) is preserved in git history and must be restored if a later release re-enables the feature (§7.6 retains BLK-1–BLK-5).
